fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (32.075885,-96.397359, RANGE_INTERPOLATED) was wrong — it placed the point ~5 km SE in open woodland/farmland on the SH-31 bypass (confirmed empty by satellite z14-z17 and Street View, captured 2024-02). Address is '4501 E. Business State Highway 31' (Business 31, not the bypass). The Pactiv plant was positively re-located at 32.0987,-96.4206 on the north side of the E State Highway 31 service road: a fully fenced plastics manufacturing complex with a long L-shaped white metal manufacturing building, a row of resin storage silos along the frontage (diagnostic of a plastics/thermoforming plant — confirmed in Street View 2024-02), a brick office building, and an extensive trailer drop yard. Plant built ~1999, ~500 employees, makes cups/lids/to-go containers/breakfast trays (corsicanadailysun, Corsicana Chamber).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence (visible in satellite and behind the highway hedge in Street View). A single access driveway connects the yard to the E SH-31 service road at the NE corner — a controlled pinch-point. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth structure is visible at the entrance in any satellite view (z18-z20). Entrance is a fenced driveway opening. Street View of the entrance itself is obscured by a tall hedge along the highway, so a small booth cannot be 100% excluded — listed uncertain. Best read: no guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no visible guard booth -> remoteGs = true (kiosk / call-box / app check-in implied). Medium confidence given hedge obstruction.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage lot on the west/southwest side of the manufacturing building — dozens of trailers parked in organized rows (visible at z18-z20). Clear dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ — counted roughly 80-100 parked trailers/storage units across the west yard rows in z18/z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Dock doors run along the south/southwest face of the manufacturing building facing the yard; estimated ~20-25 doors. Low-confidence count — roof shadow and trailer occlusion. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance driveway runs a long distance from the SH-31 service road across a deep paved apron into the yard — ample stacking room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unfenced paved aprons at the entrance and inside the yard; room to add bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing building plus a separate brick office building and at least one ancillary structure; ~3. The dense piping/tank complex immediately to the southwest is a SEPARATE property (a legacy Corsicana oil/asphalt terminal), not part of the Pactiv site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: East edge of Corsicana along the SH-31 corridor; open farmland and scattered industrial parcels around. Edge-of-town / rural.
